$comment: Sample seed for data-sourcing evaluation. Hand-researched 2026-09-09 from public web sources, NOT from Google Places (no API key yet). Per the ticket's rule, unknown fields are null and are never invented. latitude/longitude are deliberately null throughout: geocoding is the collector's job and Places returns coordinates for free, so guessing them here would only hide that they're missing.

churches.name: St. Michael's Cathedral Basilica
churches.notes: Heritage designation 1973. $125M+ restoration begun 2011. No attendance figure published.

churches.name: Cathedral Church of St. James
churches.year_basis: parish established 1797; fourth building on site opened 1853
churches.notes: Oldest congregation in Toronto. Episcopal seat of the Bishop of Toronto since 1936. 56-year gap between congregation and building year.

churches.name: Metropolitan United Church
churches.capacity_basis: 1833 Newgate Methodist Episcopal predecessor building accommodated 1,000 — HISTORICAL, not the current building
churches.notes: Denomination label needs normalizing: founded Methodist Episcopal, became United Church at 1925 church union.

churches.name: Yorkminster Park Baptist Church
churches.year_basis: building opened and dedicated 25 March 1928; congregation predates it, and Park Road Baptist merged in 1961 — no single founding year
churches.notes: Described as the largest Baptist church in Canada — a qualitative size signal with no number attached. 1961 merger makes 'founded' genuinely ambiguous.

churches.name: The Peoples Church
churches.year_basis: first meeting at Massey Hall, 9 September 1928
churches.notes: ADDRESS UNVERIFIED — congregation has relocated at least once since its original Bloor Street East site; current address not confirmed in research. Left null rather than guessed. The only attendance number found anywhere in this dataset is ~100 years stale.

churches.name: Knox Presbyterian Church
churches.year_basis: first Presbyterian congregation in the Town of York, 1820; current building first service January 1909
churches.notes: City of Toronto heritage status 2006. 89-year gap between congregation and current building.

churches.name: Little Trinity Anglican Church
churches.year_basis: cornerstone laid 20 July 1843; first services February 1844
churches.notes: Oldest surviving church building in Toronto per Ontario Heritage Trust plaque. Partly destroyed by fire 1961, rebuilt 1962.

churches.name: St. George Greek Orthodox Church
churches.year_basis: community founded 1909; building built 1897 AS A SYNAGOGUE, acquired by the parish 1937
churches.notes: Building predates the congregation by 12 years — breaks any assumption that building_year >= founded_year. Oldest Greek Orthodox community in Canada; only Greek Orthodox church in Toronto until 1961. Services partly in Greek — language filter matters here.

churches.name: Grace Toronto Church
churches.year_basis: founded 1992; re-planted 2004 after dwindling to a handful; meets in the 1878 Old St. Andrew's building
churches.notes: The one record with real service times and a real sermon feed — both scraped straight off the church's own homepage in a single fetch. Also the hardest age call in the set: 1992, 2004, or 1878 depending on what 'age' means.

churches.name: First Evangelical Lutheran Church of Toronto
churches.notes: Sits directly across Bond Street from St. Michael's Cathedral and St. George Greek Orthodox — three churches, three denominations, one block. Good stress test for map pin clustering.
